Colare raises $2.5M to help firms vet engineering candidates with advanced simulations. Engineering talent vetting startup Colare Inc. says its simulated candidate testing platform is ready for prime time today after closing on a $2.5 million pre-seed funding round backed by Afore Capital, Garage Capital and Acadian Ventures. The company has created a simulation-based technical screening platform that companies can use to assess an engineering candidate’s ability […]
